limitations: invoice_contract_association and commercial_dependency_status: PURPOSE-scoped adjudications from P5 were not persisted in 06_world/world.sqlite (0 rows); derive_purposes recomputes association and dependency status from world identity_judgment and mechanical joins.

INV-5001 asserted association from authoritative commercial_notes (P5 ACCEPT) cannot be recovered from world.sqlite alone; output reports unresolved until invoice_contract_association tuples are admitted to world.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical orthographic projection; no unresolved disposition role; tuples are symmetric variant facts.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over legal_name_form_variant_staging universe as registered in world.sqlite.
derivations.required_premise: Staging tuples enumerate deterministic legal-form abbreviation pairs grounded to registry legal_name source text.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Registry rows supply candidate legal_name strings for staging compilation upstream of this derivation.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Policy projection only; inherits ACCEPT-only world clause tuples; no closed-world absence.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Depends on incomplete contract_clause_kind candidate universe (ACCEPT tuples only in world).
derivations.required_premise: contract_clause_kind.clause_kind must be in purpose A allowed_kinds; contract_record.active must be true for downstream inclusion.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Active contract filter applied at purpose A row inclusion, not at this projection.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: contract_clause_kind UNRESOLVED candidates withheld from world do not block projection of existing ACCEPT tuples

derivations.epistemic_behavior: association field is asserted or unresolved only; unresolved association still permits row inclusion when contract is active and bears an acquisition-relevant clause.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Invoice-contract candidates generated from identity_judgment pairs linking billing:<billed_name> to contract:<contract_id>; not exhaustive Cartesian product.
derivations.required_premise: Invoice is represented billed revenue; candidate contract is active; contract bears at least one purpose-A acquisition-relevant clause_kind; billing-contract identity is not DISTINCT.
derivations.optional_enrichment: invoice_contract_association table rows override identity-derived association when present; legal_name_form_variant does not upgrade association without SAME_ENTITY judgment.
blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment DISTINCT between billing:<billed_name> and contract:<contract_id> blocks row inclusion for that pair
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED between billing:<billed_name> and contract:<contract_id> yields association unresolved but row still included
invoice_contract_association unresolved disposition maps to association unresolved without blocking inclusion

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Epistemic column mirrors identity_judgment disposition (SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, UNRESOLVED); REJECT maps to DISTINCT per purpose contract.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emits all identity_judgment tuples present in world (required link set adjudicated in P5); does not close-world infer missing pairs.
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment tuple exists in world with admitted disposition.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Record relations contextualize candidate generation upstream; derivation is a direct disposition projection.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED exported as epistemic UNRESOLVED without blocking other links

derivations.epistemic_behavior: status is dependent or unresolved only; unresolved identity on billing-crm or billing-contract paths forces unresolved even when obligation kinds and open invoices are present.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Counterparty-contract candidates from identity_judgment linking crm:<account> to contract:<contract_id>; open_invoice_ids from billed names linked via identity packets to CRM or contract.
derivations.required_premise: Active contract bears purpose-C obligation kind; current commercial relationship via open invoice or active auto_renewal/rolling_term clause; crm-contract candidate exists in identity_judgment graph.
derivations.optional_enrichment: commercial_dependency_status table rows would override recomputation when admitted to world; legal_name_form_variant does not substitute for SAME_ENTITY on required identity pairs.
blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment DISTINCT on billing:<billed_name> to crm:<account> or billing:<billed_name> to contract:<contract_id> prevents status dependent
identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on required billing-crm or billing-contract direct pairs forces status unresolved
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on crm-registry or contract-registry pairs does not alone block dependent when billing-crm and billing-contract are SAME_ENTITY
UNRESOLVED clause_kind candidates absent from world do not block dependency rows grounded on other obligation kinds
